items.title: Iran reviews U.S. peace proposal; Trump warns of 'nasty' response if no deal reached
items.summary: Trump told reporters talks are in 'final stages' and warned of a 'nasty' response if Iran fails to deliver an acceptable reply; Iran's Foreign Ministry confirmed receipt of U.S. proposal and said it is 'reviewing American views.'

items.title: Trump shifts between diplomacy and threats in Iran standoff
items.summary: Trump oscillated between diplomatic overtures and military threats, promising to seize Iran's 440 kg of highly enriched uranium — a demand Tehran immediately called a non-starter.

items.title: U.S. demands 10-year enrichment halt and HEU surrender; Iran insists on staggered approach
items.summary: Washington insists on an upfront 10-year enrichment moratorium and handover of 440 kg HEU; Tehran proposes a staggered approach (war-end first, nuclear talks later), calling HEU surrender a non-starter.

items.title: IRGC reports coordinating 26 vessel transits through Hormuz in latest 24-hour period
items.summary: Iran's IRGC Navy said it coordinated 26 vessel transits through the Strait of Hormuz, framing access as occurring under the Persian Gulf Strait Authority managed-access regime rather than open transit.

items.title: Iran free-market remittance dollar rate reaches 1,787,000 IRR/USD on May 21
items.summary: The USD remittance rate in Iran's free market hit 1,787,000 IRR on May 21, reaching 89% of the 2,000,000 threshold in portfolio questions D1 and F8; official banking rate was 1,322,540 IRR/USD.

items.title: IRGC threatens to destroy U.S. bases in southern Persian Gulf amid Hormuz standoff
items.summary: The IRGC issued threats to destroy U.S. military bases in the southern Persian Gulf as the Hormuz standoff continues; Iran has redefined the strait as a 'vast operational area' extending from Jask to Siri Island.

items.title: Polymarket: Iran ceasefire holding through May 22 at 98%; U.S.-Iran peace deal by Dec 31 at 70%
items.summary: Prediction markets show 98% confidence in ceasefire holding today and 70% for a full U.S.-Iran peace deal by December 31, 2026 — well above the portfolio's A1 framework-deal probability of 20% for September 30.

items.title: Iran protests extend into May 2026 as economy worsens; 40% inflation and rial collapse
items.summary: Iran faces its most extensive protest wave since the 2022 Mahsa Amini movement, driven by 40% inflation, rial collapse, and food insecurity; government has combined selective repression with political containment, with local elections underway in May.
